title: I was struck by that sentence
body: I’ve always dreamed of an app like this because I have a hard time motivating myself to do things on my own, especially when it comes to small tasks, but this app really helps me. It’s very interactive, there are groups with active members, and overall, the interface is user-friendly. I’m happy with everything, and I hope that over time I’ll be able to develop the habits and discipline I need to tackle all my tasks :) A big thank you to the developers and the whole team!
author: terakitt

title: Great idea for motivation.
body: Great idea to challenge yourself with dailies and duties. Sometimes it is good to have more motivation, because you want to destroy a monster. But the real challenge is to beat yourself and start doing anything. If you are a gamer, that could help you with your habbits and to get more motivation. :)
author: Hitakari

title: Have it changed my life?
body:
A bit. I still have adhd but now I feel anxious that my team could get dmg because of me not doing the dishes ;p
The only con is sometimes the phone app doesn’t work properly.
author: xjcath

title: I really like it but…
body:
I am really enjoying my process of creating new virtuous habits with Habitica. The only thing I think is missing (and if it had it I would rate the app with 5 stars) is a dashboard showing you your progress in habit tracking. Could you please include this feature?
Thank you!
author: Larassita

title: Add a Tracker
body: Please add a Widget Tracker with Day Streak like in Duolingo, it informs you about your streak and about your today’s progress.
author: Zurexus

title: The best habitica app
body: I owe so much to this app! It is affecting my life in such a positive way! I tried SO many things to take my vitamins and do my healthy habits but only this app makes me stick with it all. You don’t need to pay anything to use it but I chose to subscribe after I saw a positive impact on my life, just to support the team behind it and have a little bit of fun! But it’s not at all necessary. If you are looking for something to help you with your small habits - DOWNLOAD THIS IMMEDIATELY! :D
author: Asiuleczkavip

title: Useless
body: I cannot make weekly routines. I want to create a task and assign it to different times in different days.
author: Shsjdksoshdh

title: Tłumaczenie do poprawy
body: Sama aplikacja super, podobnie jak jej założenia i funkcjonalność, ale tłumaczenie na Polski jest fatalne a to bardzo utrudnia korzystanie z aplikacji
author: Waletko

title: Needs a tracker
body: It has a cute design and a great idea behind! This app would've been perfect, but, personally, the lack of a tracker/calendar that shows what tasks/dailies I completed in a specific date really demotivates me from using it. Really wish it was added.
author: lawaille

title: Lovely but only when it works
body: I really like the design of the app. Unfortunately, it’s not working properly most of the times. Streaks are not counting, some habits are ticking off itself, it takes a few trials to add a new task. It’s disappointing. I like the whole idea and will wait for fixing it tho.
author: Feyranire

title: They killed or sold to someone this app
body: This was my best app, but when they removed e.g. tavern chat, the game is now also very buggy (won't refresh, won't work functions like removing group members etc). Shame.
author: xAdamowY

title: Most important app on my phone
body:
My longest streak now is more than 500. I use this app daily mostly for my dailies. It's absolutely great but it's the third time I tried sticking to Habitica and it worked this time.

I also love the new colorful spinner for refresh that goes back to the Mac beach ball times
author: gdybybułekbyarchewka

title: No longer space to contact with others
body: They removed place to contact with another users with only one week warning. I lost all from my 5000 connections with is pity because it was really motivating to contact with others about same goals.
author: hulcanare

title: language problems
body: app looks amazing and i have feeling it would be really helpful but there's this problem with language. i have my phone set on my native language but i want app to work in english, when i set that language in app settings app becomes half english half my native language, changing my phone language to english didn't help. it's very annoying.

author: michcio53

title: Really good
body: If you play it right, this app will change your life, as it did mine. I don’t have the gut to substract even one star for bugs (of which there are some, mostly temporary server issues, so you close the app and try again in 2 hours) because of how good it is in what it claims to be. Don't cheat and find a way to translate the in-game rewards to real-world ones and you'll be a better version of yourself in no time!

body: Great idea, great app, there are many visual bugs on Iphone X tho. Ill change to 5  stars when they will get fixed

title: Wonderful app
body: I’ve been using Habitica for about two years now and it has a great influence on me. I recommend it to anyone who wants to improve themselves! I can’t give it five stars even though I really want to, because it’s buggy, especially the app. All the admins are extremely helpful and nice, so Habitica is still a very nice place!
